description.p: UinDub takes a PingDub master, or any interlaced SD file, and turns it into a watchable file: Edge Lock (a software time base corrector that straightens jittery lines), QTGMC or bwdif deinterlacing, IVTC for film, color and levels, free crop, trims and cuts with chapters and captions kept in place, and x265, x264 or SVT-AV1 encoding.
